resources.name: Open-source DFT code (e.g., Quantum ESPRESSO)
resources.notes: Any open-source DFT code supporting GGA-PBE can be used; the paper originally used CASTEP, but Quantum ESPRESSO is a suitable open-source alternative.

resources.name: Crystal structure data for NiTi2 and Ni2Ti4Ox

access.notes: Structures are known from literature (e.g., Mueller & Knott, 1963) and can be obtained from the Inorganic Crystal Structure Database (ICSD) or the Crystallography Open Database (COD).

resources.notes: The agent must construct supercells (1×1×1) with the appropriate occupancy of oxygen atoms at tetrahedral sites for each composition.
